Package org.drip.function.rdtor1solver

Class VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier

java.lang.Object
org.drip.function.rdtor1solver.VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier
public class VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier
extends java.lang.Object
VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier holds the Variates and their Inequality Constraint Multipliers in either the Absolute or the Incremental Forms. It exposes the following Functions:
  • Add the Specified VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier Instances together #1
  • Add the Specified VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier Instances together #2
  • Subtract the Second VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier Instance from the First #1
  • Subtract the Second VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier Instance from the First #2
  • Compare the Specified VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier Instances
  • VariateInequalityConstraintMultiplier Constructor
  • Retrieve the Incremental Flag
  • Retrieve the Array of Problem Variables
  • Retrieve the Constraint Multipliers
  • Retrieve the Consolidated Variate/Constraint Multiplier Array
  • Retrieve the Sized Vector Instance corresponding to the Increment
  • Retrieve the Sized Vector Instance corresponding to the Variate Increment
